name: Stampers
storyline:
In a world of wonderful mechanical men, Stampers is a fast-paced, high-flying, guns-blazing sport for thrill seekers and adrenaline junkies alike. 6 vs 6 dogfights between two foundries stamping out aircraft, supply drops, and most importantly: the titular Stamper bots themselves. They fly the planes, service the planes, serve as armor, man the guns, break down the wreckage and even perform mid-air repairs.

The ammunition however is live, and the stakes are human lives in the stands. All in attendance know the true price.
summary:
Stampers is a free playtest of a team aerial combat arena. Six pilots a side fly hand-built warplanes over a stadium junkyard while the crowd roars and the commentary booth calls every kill. It’s Season One.

Each team has a foundry that stamps out new airplanes. Its ground crews, the Stampers, board, repair and rearm your airplanes and crew your AA guns. Keep your foundry working and your team keeps flying.
